sloka: प्रविशत्व् अप्रमेय आत्मा बहुभिः कपिभिर् वृतः ।दैत्य दानव सम्घानाम् ऋषीणाम् च महात्मनाम् ॥६-३७-२९॥।।
transliteration: praviśatv aprameya ātmā bahubhiḥ kapibhir vṛtaḥ ।daitya dānava samghānām ṛṣīṇām ca mahātmanām ॥6-37-29॥।।

translations.english: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."
